hr.hiring.empty.title: Hire through the bot
hr.hiring.empty.body: Post a vacancy, share its link or QR code, and applicants answer a few questions in the bot. Move them on and hire in one tap.

hr.hiring.empty.step2: Share the link or QR code

hr.hiring.decide.positionLater: They choose it when creating their account
